research.tip: Set a 45‑minute study block, turn off notifications and place the phone elsewhere, then take a 10‑minute screen‑free break before the next block.

scenes.text: Sab log sochte hain ki lagataar scrolling se hi top marks milte hain, lekin yeh sirf ek galat dharna hai.
scenes.text_en: Everyone believes nonstop scrolling leads to top marks, but that's just a mistaken belief.

scenes.text: Myth: 24/7 phone use = high scores. Reality: Top performers actually schedule regular digital breaks.
scenes.text_en: Myth: Constant phone use equals high scores. Reality: Top students schedule regular digital breaks.

scenes.text: Ab aapko dikhata hoon ki top scorers ka asli secret kya hai – unka digital detox routine.
scenes.text_en: Now I'll show you the real secret of top scorers – their digital detox routine.

scenes.text: Unke teen habits mein se teesri sabse zaroori hai, aur woh aapko aaj hi batane wale hain.
scenes.text_en: Among their three habits, the third is most crucial, and I'm about to reveal it now.

scenes.text: Ruk jao, socho—agar aap har din ek ghanta phone se door rahenge, to kya farq padega?
scenes.text_en: Hold on, think—if you stay one hour away from your phone daily, what difference would it make?

scenes.text: Research suggest karta hai ki digital breaks se attention span improve hoti hai, aur stress level kam hota hai.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests that digital breaks improve attention span and lower stress levels.

scenes.text: Toh aap bhi apni padhai mein chhote breaks include karo, jaise 5‑minute walk ya eyes‑rest.
scenes.text_en: So include short breaks in your study, like a 5‑minute walk or eye rest.

scenes.text: Ab hum #3 habit pe detail mein jayenge – ek simple habit jo aapke grades ko skyrocket karegi.
scenes.text_en: Now we'll dive into habit #3 in detail – a simple habit that can skyrocket your grades.

scenes.text: Sab log sochte hain ki lagataar scrolling se hi top marks milte hain, lekin yeh sirf ek galat dharna hai.
scenes.text_en: Many believe constant scrolling brings top marks, but that's simply a mistaken belief.

scenes.text: Caption: You think more scrolling = more knowledge, par asal mein yeh sirf time ka waste hai.
scenes.text_en: Caption: You think more scrolling equals more knowledge, but actually it's just wasted time.

scenes.text: Fast cuts dikhate hain kaise notifications ek ke baad ek aate hain, aur hamara dhyan turant bhatak jata hai.
scenes.text_en: Fast cuts show how notifications pile up, instantly pulling our attention away.

scenes.text: Lekin kya aap jaante hain ki top‑scoring students is distraction ko kaise control karte hain? Aane wale minute mein batayenge.
scenes.text_en: But do you know how top‑scoring students control this distraction? We'll reveal it in the next minute.

scenes.text: Ek second ke liye ruk jao—socho, agar aapka phone aapke exam ka part hota, kya hota?
scenes.text_en: Pause for a second—imagine if your phone were part of your exam, what would happen?

scenes.text: Dekho, ek student phone ko drawer mein rakhta hai, aur phir bina interruption ke deep focus mode mein aata hai.
scenes.text_en: Watch a student place the phone in a drawer, then enter deep focus mode without interruptions.

scenes.text: Research suggest karta hai ki jab hum phone ko door rakhte hain, to hamari information retention 20% tak badh sakti hai.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests that keeping the phone away can increase information retention by up to 20%.

scenes.text: Aise habits se burnout kam hota hai, aur jab stress kam hota, to humara performance naturally improve hota hai.
scenes.text_en: These habits reduce burnout, and with less stress, performance naturally improves.

scenes.text: Ab aap bhi apni study routine mein ek chhota digital detox try karo, aur dekho kaise aapke marks skyrocket hote hain.
scenes.text_en: Now try a small digital detox in your study routine and see how your marks skyrocket.

scenes.text: Dekho, hamare topper ka study zone kitna shaant hai, phone sirf doosre kamre mein rakha hai.
scenes.text_en: Look, our top student's study area is very quiet, with the phone kept in another room.

scenes.text: Jab wo subah ki revision khatam karta, turant phone se door, ek choti si walk par nikalta hai.
scenes.text_en: When he finishes his morning revision, he immediately steps away from the phone and goes for a short walk.

scenes.text: Is walk mein wo sirf hawa, paudhe aur apne thoughts ko mehsoos karta, notifications ko ignore karta.
scenes.text_en: During this walk he feels only the breeze, plants, and his thoughts, ignoring any notifications.

scenes.text: Ab raat ko, wo ek tech‑off hour set karta, phone ko silent mode mein rakh kar kitab padhta.
scenes.text_en: At night he sets a tech‑off hour, puts his phone on silent, and reads a book.

scenes.text: Yeh ek pattern‑interrupt hai: camera zooms out, dikhata hai ki uske desk par sirf ek pen aur notebook bachi hai.
scenes.text_en: This is a pattern‑interrupt: the camera zooms out to show only a pen and notebook left on his desk.
queries: desk with only pen and notebook

scenes.text: Students sochte hain ki nonstop scrolling se unka knowledge badhega, lekin research suggest karta hai ki break se focus improve hota hai.
scenes.text_en: Students think nonstop scrolling will increase knowledge, but research suggests breaks improve focus.

scenes.text: Aap soch rahe honge, kya ye habit sabko suit karegi? Aage dekhenge kaise implement karein.
scenes.text_en: You might wonder if this habit works for everyone; we’ll see next how to implement it.

scenes.text: Ek chhota experiment try karo: agle hafte har din 30 minute phone free study zone banaye.
scenes.text_en: Try a small experiment: create a 30‑minute phone‑free study zone each day for the next week.

scenes.text: Agar aapko lagta hai stress badh raha hai, ek trusted teacher ya counselor se baat karna helpful ho sakta hai.
scenes.text_en: If you feel stress increasing, talking to a trusted teacher or counselor can be helpful.

scenes.text: Dekho, jab tum bar‑bar phone switch karte ho, har switch ko 25 µs lagte hain, dimag thak jata hai.
scenes.text_en: When you keep switching to your phone, each switch costs about 25 µs, tiring the brain.

scenes.text: Par socho, agar sirf 30 seconds ka chhota break le lo, to yeh cost kaise halve ho sakta hai – but imagine, taking just a 30‑second break could potentially halve that switching cost for you.
scenes.text_en: But imagine, taking just a 30‑second break could potentially halve that switching cost for you.

scenes.text: Jab tum 30 minute phone‑free rehte ho, research dikhata hai memory consolidation double hoti hai.
scenes.text_en: When you stay 30 minutes without phone, research shows memory consolidation can significantly improve.

scenes.text: Socho, tumhara dimaag ek library hai, aur phone ka notification usmein se ek ghanti ki tarah bajta hai!
scenes.text_en: Imagine your mind as a library, and each phone notification rings like a sudden alarm.

scenes.text: Aapko pata hai kaunse chhote step se aapka focus double ho sakta hai abhi?
scenes.text_en: Do you know which small step can instantly double your focus?
queries: close-up of phone being placed away

scenes.text: Chalo, 45 minute ka study block set karte hain, phone ko doosre kamre mein rakh ke, distraction door.
scenes.text_en: Let's set a 45‑minute study block and keep the phone in another room to eliminate distractions.
queries: phone being placed in another room

scenes.text: Ab notifications band karo, timer set karo, aur bina interruption ke padhai shuru karo, dhyan se.
scenes.text_en: Now turn off notifications, set a timer, and start studying without interruptions, focusing fully.

scenes.text: Ek minute, socho agar aapka phone aapko padhai ke liye cheerleader ban jaye abhi?
scenes.text_en: Wait, imagine if your phone became your study cheerleader right now.

scenes.text: Research suggest karta hai ki 10 minute ka screen‑free stretch break, yaadash ko boost karta hai, thakawat kam hoti hai.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests a 10‑minute screen‑free stretch break boosts memory and reduces fatigue.

scenes.text: Ab timer bajne par, phone ko side mein rakh kar, 10 minute tak bina screen ke stretch karo, deep breaths lete hue.
scenes.text_en: When the timer rings, put the phone aside and do a 10‑minute screen‑free stretch with deep breaths.

scenes.text: Break ke baad, phone wapas rakh do, timer reset karo, aur fresh mind se agla 45 minute shuru karo.
scenes.text_en: After the break, put the phone back, reset the timer, and start the next 45‑minute session with a fresh mind.

scenes.text: Aap soch rahe honge, kya ye habit aapke exam scores ko skyrocket karegi ab?
scenes.text_en: You might wonder, will this habit skyrocket your exam scores now?

scenes.text: Toh aaj se try karo, 45‑minute blocks, phone door, break stretch – aapka focus aur health dono improve honge.
scenes.text_en: So start today: 45‑minute blocks, phone away, stretch break – your focus and health will improve.

scenes.text: Ab hum aapko ek aisa raaz batayenge, jo top‑scorers ko roz ke distraction se bachata hai.
scenes.text_en: Now we'll reveal a secret that helps top‑scorers stay away from everyday distractions.

scenes.text: Challenge: aaj sirf 45 minute ka focus‑zone set karo, bina phone ke, aur dekho फर्क.
scenes.text_en: Challenge: create a 45‑minute focus zone today without your phone and notice the difference.

scenes.text: Socho, aapka brain ek high‑speed train hai—ab isko ek station pe rokna zaroori hai!
scenes.text_en: Imagine your brain as a high‑speed train; now you need to stop it at a station.

scenes.text: Jab aapka 45‑minute zone complete ho jaye, comment ‘✅ DONE’ likho aur community ko inspire karo.
scenes.text_en: When you finish the 45‑minute zone, comment ‘✅ DONE’ to inspire the community.

scenes.text: Agar aapko lagta hai focus mushkil ho raha hai, NeuroTriage par personalized tips ke liye check karo.
scenes.text_en: If focusing feels hard, visit NeuroTriage for personalized tips that match your brain pattern.

scenes.text: Jab aap regular detox karte ho, memory, creativity, aur exam scores mein natural boost milta hai.
scenes.text_en: Regular detox naturally boosts memory, creativity, and exam scores without any extra tools.

scenes.text: Agar stress ya burnout zyada lag raha ho, ek trusted teacher ya counselor se baat karna safe hai.
scenes.text_en: If stress or burnout feels heavy, talking to a trusted teacher or counselor is a safe step.

scenes.text: Yaad rakho, aapki success ka secret sirf hard work nahi, balki smart unplugging bhi hai.
scenes.text_en: Remember, the secret to your success is not just hard work but also smart unplugging.

scenes.text: Agla video mein hum deep‑work schedule ka exact template dikhayenge, jisse aap har din 3 hour focused study kar sakte hain—miss mat karna!
scenes.text_en: In the next video we’ll reveal the exact deep‑work schedule template that lets you study focused three hours daily—don’t miss it!
